subject: Earth Cave 1F
text: The first floor of the Earth Cave contains 5 chests with 1975 G, a Pure potion, 795 G, 880 G, and a Heal potion.

evidence.quote: the first floor contains 5 chests (1975 G, Pure potion, 795 G, 880 G, Heal potion).

subject: Earth Cave 1F
text: Heading west from the entrance on the first floor of the Earth Cave leads through a looping hallway where Giants are encountered every step, offering large EXP rewards for quick leveling.

evidence.quote: Heading west from the entrance on this floor will lead you through a looping hallway where you repeatedly encounter Giants each step; these enemies are sturdy and hit hard, but don't do anything special otherwise and have large EXP rewards compared to the average encounter, so if you can survive a few rounds of them you can get some quick levels on your party.

subject: Earth Cave 2F
text: Floor 2 of the Earth Cave contains 6 chests split between two treasure rooms with a Coral Sword, Cabin, 330 G, 5000 G, Wooden Shield, and 575 G.

evidence.quote: Floor 2 of the Earth Cave contains another 6 chests split between two treasure rooms (Coral Sword, Cabin, 330 G, 5000 G, Wooden Shield, 575 G).

subject: Earth Cave 3F
text: Floor 3 of the Earth Cave includes four chests before the boss room containing a Tent, Heal potion, 3400 G, and 1020 G.

evidence.quote: The lowest floor we can access right now is floor 3, which includes four chests before reaching the boss room (Tent, Heal potion, 3400 G, 1020 G)

subject: Earth Cave 3F
text: A required chest located in the left corner of Vampire's room on floor 3 contains the Ruby.

evidence.quote: and one additional **required** chest which can be opened after beating Vampire (the one in the left corner of Vampire's room; contains **Ruby** required to proceed further).

subject: Titan
text: Talking to Titan in Titan's Tunnel with the Ruby in your possession clears him out of the way.

evidence.quote: Talking to Titan with the Ruby in your possession will clear it out of the way.

subject: Titan's Tunnel
text: The south chamber of Titan's Tunnel contains 4 chests holding a Silver Helmet, 450 G, 620 G, and Great Axe.

evidence.quote: You are now free to access the treasure room in the south chamber of Titan's Tunnel, containing 4 chests (Silver Helmet, 450 G, 620 G, Great Axe).

subject: Sarda
text: Talking to the sage in Sarda's Cave grants the Rod.

evidence.quote: Take the other exit out of Titan's Tunnel now, head down to Sarda's Cave, and talk to the sage to get the Rod.

subject: Earth Cave 3F
text: Taking the Rod back to Earth Cave unlocks the stone slab accessible from the right exit of Vampire's room on floor 3, allowing descent to floor 4.

evidence.quote: Taking the Rod back to the Earth Cave will unlock the weird slab accessible from the right exit of Vampire's room on floor 3. You can now proceed down to floor 4

subject: Earth Cave 4F
text: Floor 4 of the Earth Cave features two treasure rooms with 8 chests: the top room has 5450 G, 1520 G, a Wooden Staff, 3400 G, and 1455 G, while the southwest room has 1250 G, a Silver Shield, and a Cabin.

evidence.quote: floor 4, which has two treasure rooms and a total of 8 chests (top treasure room: 5450 G, 1520 G, Wooden Staff, 3400 G, 1455 G; southwest treasure room: 1250 G, Silver Shield, Cabin).

subject: Lich
text: Lich has 400 HP, is weak to Fire and susceptible to Harm spells, neutral to Lightning and Earth, resistant to Ice, Status, Poison, and Death, and can inflict Paralysis with physical attacks.

evidence.quote: Lich statistics: 400 HP, Weak to Fire, Susceptible to Harm spells, Neutral to Lightning and Earth, Resistant to Ice, Status, Poison, and Death, physical attacks can inflict Paralysis (Fire-elemental)

subject: Lich
text: Lich has a 25% chance of using a physical attack and a 75% chance of casting magic, following a set spell order of Ice2 -> Slp2 -> Fast -> Lit2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Slow -> Slep.

evidence.quote: Lich has a 25% chance to spend its turn using a physical attack and a 75% chance of casting a spell.... Lich's spell list is Ice2 -> Slp2 -> Fast -> Lit2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Slow -> Slep.

subject: Lich
text: Lich most likely casts Ice2 on turn one dealing 80 to 160 damage without resistance, which can be mitigated if a White Magic user casts AIce before Lich acts.

evidence.quote: What this means for you is that Lich will most likely spend its first turn casting Ice2, which can deal anywhere from 80 to 160 damage if you don't resist it.... If you have access to level 4 white magic, you can try casting AIce immediately to cut in front of Lich and grant your party ice resistance, but you'll be gambling on your white magic user getting to go before Lich does.

subject: Lich
text: White magic users can cast ALit upon seeing Lich cast Fast to significantly reduce the damage of the upcoming Lit2 spell.

evidence.quote: White magic users can cast ALit upon seeing Fast to significantly reduce the damage of the upcoming Lit2.

subject: Lich
text: Dropping a Hel2 after Lich's initial Ice2 is recommended for White Mages, while casting Fir3 or Hrm3 deals massive damage to defeat Lich quickly.

evidence.quote: If you brought a White Mage, dropping a Hel2 after the initial Ice2 is probably a good idea, but outside of that your efforts should mainly be focused on making sure Lich is dead before it gets around to casting something dangerous again. Black magic users who can cast Fir3 should consider buying the spell here; a high roll from Fir3 can take out over half of Lich's health in one cast, and even a low roll does a significant chunk. The White Mage's Hrm3 is also capable of solid results and probably the best thing they could be doing if the party is at high health.

subject: Lich
text: Casting Fast on Fighters and Black Belts helps overcome Lich's physical defense by fishing for critical hits.

evidence.quote: Fighters and Black Belts may have trouble with Lich's physical defense at this point; having Fast cast on them can help to fish for critical hits.

subject: Lich
text: Level 15 to 16 is recommended for fighting Lich, and players struggling can grind levels in the giant's hallway on Earth Cave 1F or on the Peninsula of Power.

evidence.quote: Level 15 to 16 should be doable for most parties, but if you are losing a lot, you can consider going to the giant's hallway on the first floor of the Earth Cave or returning to the Peninsula of Power.

subject: Crescent Lake
text: After restoring the Earth Crystal, travelling to Crescent Lake allows you to obtain the Canoe, which immediately opens up Gurgu Volcano, the Ice Cave, and the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: Any route taken after the Earth Crystal is restored will first take you to the opposite side of the continent and the town of Crescent Lake, where you'll grab the canoe [achievement 3574]. Getting the Canoe opens up three dungeon areas immediately: Gurgu Volcano, Ice Cave, and the Castle of Ordeals.

subject: Crescent Lake
text: To reach the Castle of Ordeals, sail north along the coast past the Peninsula of Power, head west through the gap, proceed northwest past the desert into an inlet, enter the dark green river using the Canoe, disembark west, and walk through the western forest.

evidence.quote: Follow the coastline north from where you parked your ship near Crescent Lake until you see the familiar Peninsula of Power; go west through the gap, then proceed northwest past the large area of desert. The castle can be reached by sailing into the inlet above it and then trying to move down onto the darker green river; if you have the Canoe, you'll automatically anchor the ship and move onto the river in the canoe instead. From there, just move left to get onto solid ground and head through the western forest to arrive at the castle.

subject: Castle of Ordeals 1F
text: The entryway of Castle of Ordeals requires the Crown in order to proceed beyond the first floor.

evidence.quote: The Castle of Ordeals consists of an entryway followed by a teleporter maze floor and then a boss floor. The entry floor is empty; you'd be stopped from proceeding if you didn't have the Crown, but you got here in the first place, so you did indeed go get it.

subject: Castle of Ordeals 2F
text: Floor 2 of the Castle of Ordeals contains a chest in the top right room holding the Zeus Gauntlets, which cast Lit2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: Floor 2 (the teleporter maze) contains one chest in the top right room (containing the Zeus Gauntlets, which cast Lit2 when used in battle).

subject: Castle of Ordeals 2F
text: In the Castle of Ordeals teleporter maze, the correct pillars to take in order are the southern pillar, the southern pillar again, the eastern pillar, and the pillar furthest south.

evidence.quote: The correct choices are southern pillar at the first choice, southern pillar again at the second choice, eastern pillar at the third choice, and the pillar furthest south for the fourth.

subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
text: The top right treasure group on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contains the Heal Staff, which casts HEAL on use and requires fighting a guaranteed Nightmare encounter.

evidence.quote: top right: Heal Staff, grabbing it will require you to refight the guaranteed Nightmare encounter, casts HEAL on use

subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
text: The top left chests on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contain a Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, and Iron Gauntlet, while the bottom left chests contain a House, 1455 G, and 7340 G.

evidence.quote: top left: Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, Iron Gauntlet; bottom left: House, 1455 G, 7340 G).

subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
text: The throne room on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contains the Tail in a chest, which is permitted to pick up even during a Merchandise Madness challenge run.

evidence.quote: Once you've gone around the floor counterclockwise, you'll arrive at a final room with a throne. The chest in here contains the **Tail**, which you're allowed to pick up even if you're running Merchandise Madness [achievement 398476].

subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
text: Approaching the throne on Floor 3 triggers a fixed battle with one or two ZombieD, and stepping on the throne teleports the party back to the first floor to exit.

evidence.quote: Walking towards the throne will require you to fight a fixed encounter with one or two ZombieD; if you make it out of that, you can step on the throne to be teleported back to the first floor and leave the castle.

subject: Crescent Lake
text: To reach Gurgu Volcano from Crescent Lake, take the Canoe onto the river above town heading west, then take the west fork, north fork, east fork, west fork twice, and follow the path south.

evidence.quote: take your new Canoe onto the river above the town and head west. When you get to forks in the river, take the west fork, then the north one, then east, then west twice more, then follow the path when it bends south to arrive at the volcano.

subject: Gurgu Volcano 1F
text: Lava floors on Gurgu Volcano 1F drain party health when walked on but prevent random encounters from triggering.

evidence.quote: Gurgu Volcano's first floor has nothing interesting except lava floors that will sap your health when you walk on them but will also not trigger random encounters.

subject: Gurgu Volcano 2F
text: Gurgu Volcano Floor 2 contains a treasure chamber with 9 chests containing 6710 G, two Heal Potions, a Pure Potion, Cabin, Silver Gauntlet, Silver Helmet, Silver Shield, and Silver Axe.

evidence.quote: 9 of these are in one treasure chamber (containing 6710 G, Heal Potion, Heal Potion, Pure Potion, Cabin, Silver Gauntlet, Silver Helmet, Silver Shield, and Silver Axe).

subject: Gurgu Volcano 2F
text: Six additional chests scattered through the tunnels on Gurgu Volcano 2F contain 1520 G, a Silver Helmet, 4150 G, a Giant Sword, 795 G, and 650 G.

evidence.quote: The other 6 are scattered throughout the rest of the tunnels and usually guarded by forced encounters; you'll find 1520 G, Silver Helmet, 4150 G, Giant Sword, 795 G, and 650 G.

subject: Gurgu Volcano 3F
text: From the entrance of Gurgu Volcano Floor 3, proceed east to reach Floor 4 south, go to the southeast corner back up to Floor 3, then head south, west, south, and west to reach the Floor 4 stairs.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 has no chests on it; proceed east from the floor 2 entrance to get down to floor 4 (south). This section of Floor 4 also has nothing interesting in it, so go to the southeast corner to go back to Floor 3. Floor 3 continues to have nothing going on, so proceed south, west, south again, and west to the Floor 4 stairs.

subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
text: Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 North has a treasure room near the stairs with a Soft potion and 2750 G, along with another chest along the path containing 1760 G.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 (North) has a treasure room near the stairs you just went down (2 chests, Soft potion, 2750 G). Another treasure room you'll bump into along the path (one chest, 1760 G).

subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
text: A room to the northwest on Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 holds 5 chests containing 7340 G, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, 880 G, and a Pure potion.

evidence.quote: Heading northwest from there leads you to a room with 5 chests in it (7340 G, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, 880 G, Pure potion).

subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
text: On Gurgu Volcano Floor 4, a room at the fork has chests with 10 G and 155 G, and a room northeast of the fork contains a House and 2000 G.

evidence.quote: Leaving here and backtracking along the path, you'll run into a room at the fork of the path with two more chests (10 G, 155 G). Northeast of here is another chest room with two non-empty chests (House, 2000 G).

subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
text: The southern chest room on Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 contains a Wooden Staff and 1250 G, adjacent to two guaranteed encounter tiles useful for grinding levels.

evidence.quote: Go back to the fork again and head south along the path to find the last chest room on this floor (2 chests, Wooden Staff, 1250 G). This room is notable for having two guaranteed encounter tiles immediately adjacent to each other, so you can guarantee an encounter every step by walking up and down between them, which makes for a convenient way to grind some levels if you can kill the enemies quickly.

subject: Gurgu Volcano 5F
text: Floor 5 of Gurgu Volcano has one chest containing the Flame Armor to the west, guarded by an Agama along the passage and a Red D directly in front of the chest.

evidence.quote: Floor 5 has one chest, to the west of the entrance; you'll have to fight an Agama at the start of the candle-lined passage up to the chest, and the tile in front of the chest forces a further encounter with a Red D (significantly more dangerous). The chest contains the Flame Armor.

subject: Kary
text: Kary has 600 max HP, hits 6 times with physical attacks, is weak to Status, neutral to Earth, Time and Death, and resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison.

evidence.quote: Kary statistics: 600 max HP, Weak to Status, Neutral to Earth, Time and Death, Resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison, physical attacks hit 6 times

subject: Kary
text: Kary has a 62.5% chance to make a physical attack and a 37.5% chance to cast magic, cycling through Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Hold.

evidence.quote: Kary has a 62.5% chance to make a physical attack and a 37.5% chance to cast magic, with her spell cycle being Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Hold.

subject: Kary
text: Casting Hold on Kary paralyzes her with a roughly 10% chance to recover, while Slow permanently reduces her attacks per round to 1.

evidence.quote: Hold will Paralyze her, giving you completely free turns until Kary hits the roughly 10% chance to recover from it, while Slow will indefinitely reduce her number of attacks per round to 1, significantly blunting their impact.
